title: Tone on Multiple Speakers
description: Play notes on three buzzers, one after another.

steps.clip: Grab an Arduino Uno and its USB cable, a breadboard, piezo buzzer and a few jumper wires.
Push the buzzer into the breadboard, its two legs in two different columns.
hints: The + leg is marked on the top (and is usually longer).
It only works one way round.
steps.goal: Put the buzzer on the breadboard.

steps.clip: A jumper wire from the + leg's column to pin 6 on the Arduino.
hints: tone() on this pin makes the buzzer sing.
steps.goal: Connect the buzzer's + leg to pin 6.

steps.clip: A jumper wire from the other leg's column to the − (blue) row along the bottom edge — and, since this is the first thing using it, one more wire from that − row to a GND pin on the Arduino (now the whole row is GND).
steps.goal: Connect the buzzer's − leg to GND.
